text:
Ravenous Strigoi
​
Introduction
Ravenous Strigoi are large beasts located in Shuruk-Ba. They are slayer monsters that require the completetion of Heralds of Crimson to kill.
​
Stats
⬥  level: 104
⬥  XP per kill: 4,549
⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~250 ,  (All AFK) / ~470 Hybrid Active  
⬥ Optimal  XP per hour: ~1.14m ,  (All AFK) / ~2100k Hybrid Active  
​
Desirable drops
⬥ Nightblood ring
⬥ Forgotten painting piece (1-5)
⬥ Crimson ichor
​
Disclaimer
⬥ IF YOU CANNOT GET A METHOD TO WORK DO NOT MESSAGE THE CREATOR(S)
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is more than likely user error or cutting corners, use #pvm-help if you cannot get it to work
​
Location and How to Get there
Either:
⬥ From the Canoe station in Heathervein
⬥ Stonevein Amulet provides close teleports to Divine Fall and Unicorn Mural

​
Positioning - AFK

​
Method - AFK Necro 
​
Preset Suggestions
Necro 
​
Action Bars

​
Example Kills
⬥ AFK Necro
​
Method - AFK Ranged 
​
Preset Suggestions
Ranged 
​
Action Bars

​
Example Kills
⬥ High Level AFK Ranged
⬥ Low Level AFK Ranged
​
Method 2: Hybrid Magic + Ranged
​
Positioning - Active

​
Preset Suggestions
⬥ Magic / Ranged  
​

Rotation
Once the cannon is placed, stay near the large wall and use it to avoid attacks from the west Strigois while simultaneously walking them into AoE range of each other. The cannon should be able to tag all 4 Strigois in the area if placed correctly. From there, alternate  +  ultimates while keeping an eye on your adrenaline buff  duration to end on full adrenaline for the next style. Use   +  to capitalise on any Strigoi you manage to lure close to each other.
​
Ranged rotation:  →  →  →  →  →   →   →  for AoE +  /  /  for single-target → end on  /  to top up adrenaline
​
Magic rotation:  →  +  →  →  →   →  →  for AoE +  /  /  for single-target → end on  /  to top up adrenaline
​
Example Kills
  Method 2: Hybrid Magic + Ranged
